question: How does hearing the formula remove death pain even for one overcome by great delusion?
premises: Death pain is born from severing the breaths
Hearing the formula removes that pain immediately
Even the greatly deluded gradually attain the goal
inference: The death mantra removes dying pain and leads even deluded hearers gradually to attainment.
uncertainties: prāṇādiccheda may mean cutting off prāṇa and other vital functions
kramādgataḥ may qualify the person or the goal
plain_english: Hearing which, it immediately removes the death pain born from severing the breaths; even one overcome by great delusion gradually attains.
